motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Press feedback and state transitions; 150 to 260 ms in the app.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: #dafa9c; color: #0f0f0f; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font: 500 13px/1 'Stack Sans Text', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #e9ffbd; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #dafa9c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Stop run: transparent with a red edge.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: transparent; color: #ff8a80; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #ff8a80; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font: 500 13px/1 'Stack Sans Text', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #ff8a80; color: #0f0f0f; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #dafa9c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Live Tile
components.description: The reading that matters now, in lime, with its source named.
components.html: Stage 3 of 5100VUs, 52 s of 60 s
components.css: .ds-tile { background: #dafa9c; color: #0f0f0f; border-radius: 6px; padding: 18px 20px 26px; display: grid; gap: 6px; width: 260px; font-family: 'Stack Sans Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tile-l, .ds-tile-s { color: #3d4a24; font-size: 13px; } .ds-tile-v { font: 300 44px/1 'Stack Sans Headline', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.03em; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Status word with its tone colour.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid currentColor; color: #8fe3a6; font: 500 12px/1.5 'Stack Sans Text', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Macro looks like a well-kept test bench: a dark, flat field where the instrument readings are the only bright things. Lime marks the one live or primary thing on a screen, and large light-weight figures carry the numbers people came for.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces, no shadows, no gradients; depth comes from three tonal steps.
One accent, lime, used as a fill; olive where the accent must be text in light mode.
Numbers lead: titles and readings in Stack Sans Headline 300, everything else in Stack Sans Text.
State colours only where they carry meaning, always with words.

rules.name: The One Live Thing Rule
rules.body: On any screen, lime marks one thing: the primary action, or the answer that matters now.

rules.name: The Olive Swap Rule
rules.body: If the accent is text, a line or a focus ring, use --accent-text: lime in dark mode, olive in light mode.

rules.name: The Readings Rule
rules.body: Headline 300 is for titles and numbers only; controls, labels and data stay in Stack Sans Text.

dos: Do name the source of every number on screen (which stage, which limit).
Do keep status words next to every colour signal.
Do use the shared tokens.css for any new surface, and both themes.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glass or glows.
Don't put a badge or label above a heading as an eyebrow.
Don't use lime as text on a light ground; use olive.
Don't show internal requirement terms (Supervisor_Agent, Stop_Thresholds) in copy.
